finding.headline: "The Visa-Denied-Granny Replacement"
finding.problem: "Mama's visa came back refused. The baby came. So did the depression. Just long days, longer nights, and spotty WhatsApp calls."
finding.person: New diaspora mum whose mother's omugwo visit was refused a visa; sliding toward PPD with "no pepper soup, no one to hold the baby while she sleeps" (OLADAM, 2025).
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone — "Crowdsource Your Omugwo: Building a Village Abroad When Mama Can't Come."". Verdict: PASSES (highest urgency + identity threat).
